meta.title: FreeModel
meta.description: Finds models that are free right now on OpenRouter, Groq's free plan (opt-in), SenseNova's Token Plan beta (opt-in) and Alibaba Cloud Bailian (opt-in, confirmation + allowlist), probes them and lists the ones that work. A tier-2 manual registry (ZCode / Qoder / WorkBuddy) is available but never probed by default: probing goes only through dsh, at most once per model per day, and only with both switches on. An automatic best-model route and default-model switch are also available (both off by default). Keys stay in dsh's credential store.
